description: This file defines classes related to providing predicates for stream namespace filtering in Orleans broadcasting, including default predicates and a constructor-based predicate provider.

classes.name: DefaultChannelNamespacePredicateProvider
classes.description: Provides stream namespace predicates based on common patterns like wildcard, regex, and exact match.

classes.name: ConstructorChannelNamespacePredicateProvider
classes.description: Provides stream namespace predicates by constructing predicate objects via reflection, supporting a specific pattern format.

methods.name: TryGetPredicate
methods.description: Attempts to parse a predicate pattern string and produce an appropriate IChannelNamespacePredicate object, returning true if successful.

methods.name: FormatPattern
methods.description: Constructs a predicate pattern string for a given predicate type and optional constructor argument.
